B: Hello! Kerry? Karim.
A: Hi, yeah. Hi.
B: Okay, I have to ask straight away. Is that the original Biscuit? In the bed by the doors?
A: [laughs] Yeah, that's him. Why?
B: Because I've now met three Biscuits today. Yours, Holly's, and a spaniel in Exeter. I've decided yours was the first.
A: Oh, right. [laughs] It's quite common, I think. The kids picked it.
B: It's a good name. Your kitchen, by the way. I saw the photo and felt very bad about my hallway. I've had paint testers on the wall for about a year.
A: [laughs] We did it last year. It was a nightmare while it was going on, honestly. Grey and gold.
B: It looks like a showroom. What do you do?
A: Funnily enough, I'm in a showroom. I'm a senior service advisor at a car dealership near Cheltenham. Premium brand. Booking in services and repairs, explaining it to customers, selling service plans and that.
B: Okay, I need your help, then. My car. Every time the light comes on, I just ignore it till it goes away. Is that bad?
A: That's bad, yeah. [laughs] Which light?
B: The orange one. With the little engine.
A: Yeah, you want that looked at. Honestly, that's how people end up with a big bill. A service plan would sort you out. You pay monthly and you don't have to think about it.
B: See, you're good. Two minutes in and you've sold me something.
A: [laughs] Sorry, it's habit. What do you do?
B: Commercial director at a food importer in Smethwick. So I'm basically in the car all week between suppliers, on the M5, late for everything. My boot's full of samples, Turkish snacks, pistachio cream. I got a parking ticket last week because I forgot to pay. Just forgot.
A: Oh no. I sit on the A435 every morning, it's terrible going into Cheltenham.
B: Is it a long week for you?
A: Monday to Friday, and one Saturday in four. And then the school run on top. I've got two, eleven and eight. I'm shattered by Friday. Friday's a pink gin and the sofa.
B: I've got an eleven-year-old as well. Lina. She's teaching me TikTok. Is yours at secondary?
A: Isla's just started, yeah. Year 7. It's a big jump.
B: Mine's Year 6, so next year. My wife's already got a spreadsheet. Do you go away much, holidays?
A: Every year. Lanzarote probably next, all-inclusive. We did Orlando in 2022.
B: Orlando! Did you like it?
A: The kids loved it. It was expensive, though. Like, really. We're still sort of paying for it, if I'm honest.
B: Honestly, that's everyone. My wife plans ours, Turkey usually, or her family in Amman. If it was me we'd turn up somewhere with no hotel.
A: Oh, I couldn't do that. I need it all booked.
B: That's why my wife married me, so somebody would. No, other way round, actually. I married her so somebody
